tasks.name: Mobile Menu Logic
tasks.description: Implement a full-screen responsive mobile navigation menu overlay triggered by MobileMenuIcon, adhering to zero-visual-spec strict implementation rules.
acceptance: Clicking MobileMenuIcon opens a full-screen navigation overlay displaying all layout navLinks.
The overlay must feature an explicit, accessible close button (X) to dismiss the view.
Body scroll lock must be active when the menu is open by dynamically applying an 'overflow-hidden' utility to the document root/body.
Clicking any navigation link must successfully route the user and automatically close the mobile menu view.
Mobile menu state, events, and DOM hooks must fully survive Astro's ClientRouter transitions without hanging listeners or memory leaks (bind via 'astro:page-load').
Complex animation triggers or open/close state logic calculations must be extracted to a helper function within a utils file.

tasks.name: Section: Home Intro & Interactive Hobbies
tasks.description: Implement the complete Home section for desktop and mobile based on the provided visual references (02-about.png). The Astro container component already exists and must not be recreated. Focus only on the internal section structure, responsive layout, typography hierarchy, interactive hobby behavior, image transitions, localization support, and strict visual parity with the design references.
acceptance: Implement the Home section — this is NOT a Hero component. The Astro wrapper/container already exists and must be reused.
Desktop layout must match the reference exactly: horizontal composition with the avatar image positioned on the right side and the text content block aligned on the left side.
Desktop navbar spacing and top alignment must visually match the reference with sufficient horizontal whitespace and centered vertical alignment.
Mobile layout must stack content vertically in this order: top controls/header, avatar image centered, intro text block below image.
On mobile, all typography and spacing must match the reference proportions with large multi-line heading text and increased paragraph readability.
The following words must use <strong>: 'frontend', 'backend', 'CI/CD', 'inteligencia artificial generativa', 'machine learning'  and 'LLMs'
All Home section textual content must come from data/about.
The data/about source must support both Spanish and English localized versions.
Language switching must dynamically swap all Home section content using the existing localization approach of the project.
The default avatar image must be 'working.png'.
Desktop avatar sizing must visually match the reference with the character occupying a significant vertical area without overpowering the typography.
Mobile avatar sizing must be reduced proportionally and centered with balanced spacing above the heading.
Desktop text block must maintain readable line length and left alignment exactly as shown in the reference.
Mobile typography must wrap naturally into multiple lines exactly like the screenshot reference.
The section background must preserve the dark navy aesthetic from the reference.
Spacing between paragraphs must match the visual rhythm shown in both references.
The implementation must preserve responsiveness across intermediate tablet widths without broken alignment.
All interactive logic must be extracted into reusable helper/util functions where appropriate.
No inline hardcoded content is allowed inside the component.
Implementation must strictly match the provided visual references for both desktop and mobile.
The icon diamond is in components/icons
The color for strong text must be --color-word

tasks.name: Section: Professional Experience Interactive Display
tasks.description: Implement the 'Mi Experiencia' section. This component must act as a dynamic display for professional roles, featuring a vertical tab system for desktop and a touch-enabled carousel for mobile. Localization and strict adherence to visual references (03-experience-C3, 03-experience-liverpool, 03-experience-sngular, 03-experience-STC) are mandatory.
acceptance: Implement the Experience section using the existing Astro container/wrapper. Do NOT recreate the outer layout structure.
Desktop Layout (Ref: 03-experience.png): Must feature a two-column layout. Left column contains a vertical list of company names (tabs); right column displays the detailed role information.
Mobile Layout (Ref: 03-experience-liverpool.png): Must transform the layout into a vertical stack where the company details are navigable via a horizontal carousel or slider with pagination dots.
Data Structure Flexibility: The agent is authorized to modify or define the 'data/experience' structure to optimize the implementation, as the final API will be modeled based on this schema.
Desktop Tab Behavior: Clicking a company name must update the right-hand content block (Title, Company with @, Dates, Description, and Tech Tags) without a page reload.
Active State: The selected company in the desktop list must have a distinct background/active style and the diamond icon visibility as shown in the reference.
Mobile Carousel: Implement touch/swipe support for navigating between different job experiences. Pagination dots must reflect the current active index.
Visual Hierarchy: The job title must be white, and the company name (prefixed with '@') must use the brand blue color.
Tech Tags: Implement a flex-wrap container for technology tags at the bottom of each description. Tags must have rounded corners and the specific blue background seen in references.
Localization: All content (Job titles, dates, descriptions) must be pulled from data files supporting English and Spanish. Switching language must update the experience content dynamically.
Typography: Maintain strict visual parity with the reference headings ('Mi Experiencia') and paragraph leading (line height).
Iconography: Use the diamond icon from 'components/icons' for the desktop list items.
Styling: Paragraphs must match the rhythmic spacing and dark navy background aesthetic of the '03-experience.png' reference.
No hardcoded content: All text and company names must be mapped from the data source.
Intermediate Breakpoints: Ensure a smooth transition between the desktop tab list and the mobile carousel without layout breakage.
Util Functions: Logic for tab switching or carousel indexing should be extracted into reusable helper functions.

tasks.name: Section: Portfolio Adaptive Project Display
tasks.description: Implement the 'Mi Portafolio' section. The component must transition from a multi-column grid layout on desktop to an interactive accordion-style list on mobile. The project data structure must be flexible to support conditional rendering of external links (Repo, Demo, Article).
acceptance: Implement the Portfolio section using the existing Astro container. Reuse typography and background tokens for consistency.
Desktop Layout (Ref: 04-portafolio.png): Implement a responsive 3-column grid (or 2-column for smaller screens) displaying project cards.
Mobile Layout (Ref: 04-portafolio.png): Transform the grid into a vertical list of expandable/collapsible items (Accordion). Only one project should ideally be expanded at a time to maintain focus.

Conditional Links: Project cards/items must support and conditionally render three types of links: 'repo' (GitHub icon), 'demo' (External link icon), and 'article' (Document/File icon). If a link is missing in the data, its icon must not appear.
Card Content: Each project must display: Diamond icon, Title, Description, a row of Tech Tags, and the Action Icons (links).
Data Structure Flexibility: The agent is authorized to modify the 'data/portfolio' schema. Suggested structure: { title, description, tags: [], links: { repo?, demo?, article? } }.
Desktop Hover Effects: Implement a subtle scale or shadow transition on the cards to match the '04-portafolio.png' aesthetic. The action icons should be clearly visible but can have hover states.

Mobile Accordion Logic: Each item shows the diamond icon and title by default. Clicking the title or the arrow icon toggles the visibility of the description, tags, and links with a smooth transition.
Tech Tags: Render tags using the same styling as the Experience section (rounded borders, specific blue background).
Localization: Pull all titles and descriptions from localized data sources. Support dynamic swapping between English and Spanish without page reload.
Visual Parity: Typography hierarchy for 'Mi Portafolio' and the 'ver más' button at the bottom must strictly match the references.
Iconography: Use icons from 'components/icons'. Ensure the arrow icons (up/down) in mobile match the reference 04-portafolio.png.
No Hardcoded Content: All project details must be mapped from the data/portfolio source.
Strict Responsive Design: Ensure the layout doesn't break at tablet widths, transitioning cleanly from grid to accordion.

tasks.name: Section: Contact & Global Footer
tasks.description: Implement the 'Hablemos' (Contact) section and the global footer. This section serves as the final call to action. It must maintain a specific viewport height in mobile to accommodate the social media bar properly, as per the visual references (06-contact.png and 06-contact-m.png).
acceptance: Implement the Contact section using the existing Astro container. Maintain strict visual parity with '06-contact.png'.
CTA Button: The 'Escríbeme' button must be a 'mailto' integration. Ensure the email address is pulled from a global configuration or data file.

Mobile Viewport Height: DO NOT modify the specific height logic of the mobile container. It is intentionally designed to ensure the social media bar is visible at the bottom of the screen (Ref: 06-contact.png).
Desktop Layout: Center all content (Heading, Paragraph, Button) both horizontally and vertically within the section.
Global Footer: Implement the 'Diseñado y Construido por @carloscndev' text at the absolute bottom. This text must be localized.
Typography & Emoji: The heading 'Hablemos' must include the waving hand emoji (👋). Ensure the font weight and size match the reference exactly.
Button Styling: The button must have a transparent background with a solid blue border and blue text, matching the '06-contact.png' visual style. Implement a subtle hover state.
Social Media Bar (Mobile): Ensure the social icons (Instagram, LinkedIn, GitHub) are aligned horizontally at the bottom of the mobile view, respecting the existing spacing.
Social Media Bar (Desktop): Ensure the vertical social bar on the left remains consistent and does not overlap with the centered contact content.
Localization: The 'Let's Talk' message, the description paragraph, the button text, and the footer credits must all support English and Spanish dynamic switching.
Data Source: The agent may define the 'data/contact' structure for the email and text content. No hardcoded strings are allowed.
Visual Parity: Paragraph width and line-height must match the centered, breathable layout shown in the desktop reference.
